description: Market Details. Calls only GET /v4/markets/{marketAddress} and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching details about a specific market on Solana. Details are filtered by market or pool address on Pump.fun, Raydium, and more.

marketAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/markets/{marketAddress}.

name: get-market
title: Market Details
